Install

The quickest way to install is the install script:

    curl -fsSL https://get.tooling.example/install.sh | bash

It downloads the latest release for your platform into ~/.local/bin. To pin a version:

    curl -fsSL https://get.tooling.example/install.sh | bash -s -- --version 1.8.2

Prefer to inspect the script first? Download it, read it, then run it:

    curl -fsSLo install.sh https://get.tooling.example/install.sh && less install.sh && bash install.sh

Uninstall with: rm -rf ~/.local/bin/tooling ~/.config/tooling
